_note: Strategy ideas the Quant Lab tests. Each runs on every symbol in 'universe_groups'. Grids are kept small on purpose: more combinations = more chance of a lucky fake.
_backtest_years_note: Backtests use the last N years (more years = slower; 12 covers 2014+, incl. 2020 crash and 2022 bear market). Add 'sp500' to universe_groups to test on all S&P 500 stocks.
